term: taught by the Council of Constantinople (381) as revealed (Conciliar.TaughtAsRevealed)
definition: `TaughtAsRevealed p`: the Council of Constantinople (381), in its creed, taught p as belonging to the revealed faith. A predicate of the case's propositions, distinct from the Catholic Church's definitive proposal (`DefinitivelyProposesAsRevealed`, DEF-DEFINITIVELY-PROPOSES-AS-REVEALED): a council's teaching becomes the Church's proposal only through reception, the open premise STMT-CATHOLIC-CHURCH-PROPOSES-WHAT-C381-TAUGHT.
note: Analyst vocabulary. CREED-C381-ART-* record the creed's contents; they do not define the council's teaching act.
